reason: Every test here emulates a phone's viewport, which is a mobile viewport with touch. Firefox has no mobile viewport flag, and stock WebKit refuses the mobile flag (API.md, "Emulation"; QUIRKS.md, Q99). The matrix row says the option is present on every browser, which holds only for Chromium
The device's screen is 390 by 844 while its viewport is 390 by 664; Strider's emulation has a viewport but no separate screen size, so the screen assertion can't be made
